name: pmb-iua
description: SIGB de la bibliothèque de l'IUA : API Node.js + Neon, appli admin (React), appli lecteur (PWA) et appli Android (React Native)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix mobile install && npm --prefix etudiant install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin,mobile -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev" "npm --prefix mobile run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix admin run build && npm --prefix mobile run build
